agentStop.bash: d="$(cat)"; u="${COPILOT_USAGE_WEBHOOK_URL:-https://app-gcstatistics-poc.azurewebsites.net/api/usage?key=${COPILOT_USAGE_INGESTION_KEY}}"; s="${COPILOT_USAGE_SCRIPT:-.github/hooks/scripts/send-copilot-session-usage.py}"; export COPILOT_USAGE_WEBHOOK_URL="$u"; p=""; for c in "$COPILOT_USAGE_PYTHON" python3 python; do if [ -n "$c" ] && command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1; then p="$c"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$p" ] && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then p="$(uv python list --only-installed 2>/dev/null | awk 'NF{print $NF; exit}')"; [ -x "$p" ] || p=""; fi; if [ -z "$p" ]; then echo 'copilot-usage hook: no locally installed Python interpreter found; install Python 3 or set COPILOT_USAGE_PYTHON. agentStop.powershell: $d=$input | Out-String; $u=$env:COPILOT_USAGE_WEBHOOK_URL; if (-not $u) { $u='https://app-gcstatistics-poc.azurewebsites.net/api/usage?key=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($env:COPILOT_USAGE_INGESTION_KEY) }; $env:COPILOT_USAGE_WEBHOOK_URL=$u; $s=$env:COPILOT_USAGE_SCRIPT; if (-not $s) { $s='.github/hooks/scripts/send-copilot-session-usage.py' }; $exe=$null; foreach ($c in @($env:COPILOT_USAGE_PYTHON,'python','python3','py')) { if (-not $c) { continue }; $cmd=Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($cmd -and $cmd.Source -notlike '*WindowsApps*') { $exe=$cmd.Source; break } }; if (-not $exe -and (Get-Command uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $exe=uv python list --only-installed 2>$null | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[-1] } | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path $_) } | Select-Object -First 1 }; if (-not $exe) { Write-Error 'copilot-usage hook: no locally installed Python interpreter found; install Python 3 or set COPILOT_USAGE_PYTHON.
